title: LLM gets priority with no pending action (choose_action returns no_pending_action)
description:
choose_action returns error_code="no_pending_action" when the LLM calls it but the player has no pending action from XMage. This should never happen — the harness should only give the LLM control when a callback is pending.

Observed 29 times across epoch 4-7 games (out of 8174 choose_action calls). Still happening in epoch 7: 11 instances across Llama4, Kimi25, GPT5m, Sonnet, and GLM47. Not model-specific.

The root cause is likely a timing issue in the bridge or pilot loop where the LLM is prompted to act before a callback has arrived, or after a callback was already consumed by auto-pass/loop detection.

This is distinct from the auto-populate race (fixed in this PR) where get_action_choices wasn't called first — those cases had a pending action but no cached choices.
